_comment: MOCK dataset - real rows lifted from `rig derive --format tsv` on the MedDBase store (66908ed06925-dirty), reshaped into the per-file findings payload the file lens NEEDS but /api/file-effects does not yet return. Every finding is LINE-ANCHORED, so it is valid ONLY for that store: the client compares `store` below against the store being viewed and suppresses all findings on a mismatch rather than mis-anchoring them. Regenerate with scripts (see the backlog card) after every re-index, or delete this file once the server ships hazards / amplifications / anchors on /api/file-effects.
